title: TESTING.md states the current JDK 22 / Ubuntu CI baseline, points at the floor files instead of copied test counts, names all five GitHub Packages repositories and no longer claims a macOS CI lane

criteria.given: the CI section and the environment prerequisites of TESTING.md
criteria.then: they state the JDK 22 on ubuntu-latest CI baseline and the matching local JDK 22 prerequisite
it points readers at .github/test-floors.json (and .coverage-thresholds.json) instead of copying test-count totals, and carries none of the obsolete numbers (the 252/44 floors, the ~990 test total)
it names all five Spicule GitHub Packages repositories, including github-ossie

criteria.given: the local Windows guidance of TESTING.md
